runes.name: Rune of Splinters
runes.short: Hits splinter to a second foe
lines: When a needle hits, a splinter flies to the nearest other enemy within 6 m for 30% of the damage. Under a scythe, each reaping swing throws one splinter, from the nearest enemy it struck to the nearest one it missed.
runes.lore: The needle shatters on bone and the shards keep looking.
runes.sources: the Gravedigger King; elites and Grave Surges in any hunting ground; chests in the Catacomb Depths

runes.name: Rune of Marrow-Tap
lines: Each needle hit returns 4 more Grave Essence. Under a scythe, each swing that lands returns 4 more once, however many enemies it strikes.
runes.cost: Needles and scythe swings hit for 30% less.
runes.sources: the Gravedigger King; elites and Grave Surges in any hunting ground; chests in the Catacomb Depths

runes.name: Rune of the Volley
lines: Every 4th needle you throw becomes a volley of 3, aimed at 3 different enemies within 9 m (or all at one target if it stands alone). The volley returns the essence of one needle between them. Needle only: a scythe's swing is not a volley.
runes.sources: the Bone Abbess; elites and Grave Surges in the Marrow Ossuary and deeper; chests in the Catacomb Depths

runes.name: Ossuary Ring Rune
lines: Instead of a line, bone erupts in a 3 m ring at the cursor, striking everything inside and applying Fracture and Hemorrhage as usual.
runes.cost: It no longer reaches down a long line, and strikes for 80%.
runes.lore: The dead rise in a circle, like a congregation.
runes.sources: the Bone Abbess; elites and Grave Surges in the Marrow Ossuary and deeper; chests in the Catacomb Depths

runes.name: Rune of Impaling
runes.short: Skewers and roots the first foe
lines: The spear stops at the first enemy it meets, hits it for 50% more and roots it for 1.5 s (a boss shrugs the root off but takes the hit).
runes.cost: It no longer pierces the line behind.
runes.sources: the Bone Abbess; elites and Grave Surges in any hunting ground; chests in the Catacomb Depths

runes.name: Mass Grave Rune
runes.short: Raise up to 3 corpses at once
lines: Exhume raises up to 3 corpses near the cursor at once, each with 75% of the usual thrall health and damage.
runes.cost: Each thrall is weaker, and it spends more corpses.
runes.lore: Why dig one grave when the field is full?
runes.sources: the Gravedigger King; elites and Grave Surges in the Marrow Ossuary and deeper; chests in the Catacomb Depths

runes.name: Bone Colossus Rune
runes.short: Five corpses become one giant thrall
lines: When 3 or more corpses lie within 6 m of the one you name, Exhume consumes up to 5 of them and raises one Bone Colossus instead. With fewer, or while a Colossus stands, it raises an ordinary thrall.
Its health is 4.0x and its damage 3.5x a thrall's with five corpses (less with fewer), and every blow cleaves 2.4 m.
It fills 2 legion places and you can only keep one: raising another replaces it.
runes.cost: Exhume takes 4 s to ready again after raising a Colossus.
runes.lore: Five dead, bound as one, and it remembers being a wall.
runes.sources: the Bone Abbess, the Plague Saint; elites and Grave Surges in the Bell Sanctum and deeper; chests in the Catacomb Depths (from depth 10)

runes.name: Creeping Rot Rune
lines: The circle drifts 1.5 m/s toward the nearest enemy within 12 m of it.
runes.lore: Rot that has learned to walk.
runes.sources: the Drowned Congregation, the Plague Saint; elites and Grave Surges in any hunting ground; chests in the Catacomb Depths

runes.name: Contagion Rune
lines: A Withered enemy that dies spreads its Withered stacks (minus one) to the 2 nearest enemies within 4.5 m, and those spread it again when they die (it needs 2 stacks to jump).
runes.lore: It does not stop at the grave.
runes.sources: the Drowned Congregation, the Plague Saint; elites and Grave Surges in the Marrow Ossuary and deeper; chests in the Catacomb Depths

runes.name: Hollow Choir Rune
runes.short: Your thralls sing instead of dying
lines: Black Litany no longer sacrifices your thralls. They still lend their voices to its power.
runes.lore: The dead sing, and are not spent.
runes.sources: the Drowned Congregation, the Plague Saint; elites and Grave Surges in the Marrow Ossuary and deeper; chests in the Catacomb Depths

runes.name: Requiem Rune
runes.short: The burst lands 2 s later, twice as wide
lines: Black Litany marks the ground, then bursts 2 s later over 1.7x the radius. Corpses and thralls are consumed when it bursts.
runes.cost: Enemies can walk out of it, and it can take more of your thralls.
runes.lore: A hymn is only terrible once it is finished.
runes.sources: the Plague Saint; elites and Grave Surges in the Bell Sanctum and deeper; chests in the Catacomb Depths (from depth 10)
